_master_game: THE MASTER GAME — Paul's interests are facets of one universal high-leverage game (truth/wealth/creation/business/AI/tools/healing/consciousness); boxing/BR is one instrument. The breadth IS the anti-echo protection: aiming at the universal game, not narrow taste, keeps the gold-sense independent.
_comment: TRAJECTORY ≠ TASTE. This file models WHERE PAUL IS POINTED — the master-game domains he is pointed at (the STANDING AIM) plus the concrete projects he is building right now (CURRENT INSTRUMENTS). It is the AIM for the questions, not the definition of gold. The Elicitor reads this to point its questions across the master game, not just boxing. updateTrajectory() sharpens this AIM (the master-game domains and the current instruments) from the direction that acted-on gold items reveal. It NEVER edits the gold rubric. The gold gate is independent and forensic (leverage × fit × durability/truth; non-obviousness is only a small optional bonus, never a gate) and is scored against value-in-the-world, NOT against this file and NOT against Paul's past approvals. Aim is Paul's; gold-definition stays sovereign.
_distinction: AIM (this file) = which universal domains Paul is pointed at → steers WHICH questions get asked, spread across the master game. GOLD (scoring rubric in elicitor.js) = is there real, durable, high-leverage value that advances the master game → steers WHICH answers survive. Value ≠ novelty: an obvious-but-undone answer can be gold. Conflating AIM and GOLD turns the gate into an echo chamber of Paul's own taste. They must never merge.
